annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2023/975 of 15 May 2023 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/417 laying down guidelines for the management of the European Union Rapid Information System 'RAPEX'
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2023/975 of 15 May 2023 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/417 laying down guidelines for the management of the European Union Rapid Information System 'RAPEX'
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 132/77
annotation.summary_en: Commission Implementing Decision amending the RAPEX (Safety Gate) guidelines by adding Annex II, which sets out joint controllership between the Commission and national authorities under GDPR and Regulation 2018/1725 for personal data in the product-safety alert system. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Commission and national authorities are joint controllers of Safety Gate/RAPEX personal data
Allocates responsibilities for data subject information and requests
Security incidents notified between controllers within 48 hours; breaches to supervisor within 72 hours
Retention periods: users while active, inspectors 5 years, other persons 30 years
Disputes settled by consultation, mediation or CJEU
